$comment: Product claims registry (WS6). A clean claims lint means the repository follows THIS registry. It is NOT FTC approval, NOT legal compliance, and NOT independent certification.
disclaimer: A passing claims lint asserts only that public copy matches the wording approved in this registry. It does not substantiate any claim, does not constitute legal review, and is not an independent audit or certification.

allowedWording: 6 included with Thesmos Free, 62 with Thesmos Pro

claims.qualification: Owner-approved repository truth. The external Gumroad checkout currently shows $24 and MUST be aligned before any deployment. Do not describe updates as 'lifetime' until the commercial terms define the scope.

claims.claim: The configured CI gate can block a change when it detects an in-scope BLOCKER finding.
allowedWording: The configured CI gate can block a change when it detects an in-scope BLOCKER finding
Reports BLOCKER findings detected by the enabled rule set
claims.qualification: Scoped to enabled rules on supported surfaces. Findings outside the configured scope are not detected.

claims.claim: Security posture is internally reviewed, not independently audited.
allowedWording: Internally reviewed against the documented threat model; this is not an independent security audit
claims.qualification: No third-party security audit has been performed or commissioned. Any claim implying one is prohibited.

claims.claim: Thesmos assists with selected control checks and does not establish legal compliance.
allowedWording: Helps assess selected GDPR, HIPAA or EU AI Act controls; it does not establish legal compliance
claims.qualification: Compliance is a legal determination made by counsel, not by a scanner.

claims.claim: Thesmos generates a versioned verification report.
allowedWording: Thesmos verification report generated by version X using rule catalog digest Y
claims.qualification: An internally generated report is not an independent certification and must never be presented as one.

claims.claim: Model-tier routing can reduce cost relative to a deep-reasoning baseline.
allowedWording: estimated saving vs the deep-reasoning baseline
prohibitedWording: cheapest model that gets it right
claims.qualification: Figures are estimates derived from the model registry's dated price windows. Unknown pricing reports 'unknown', never a number.

claims.claim: Any absolute quality or safety promise.
claims.qualification: No evidence can substantiate an absolute promise about software behaviour. These are prohibited outright.

claims.claim: Statements about credential and payment-data handling.
claims.qualification: These are factual assertions about payment and credential infrastructure that this repository cannot substantiate. They require a documented data-flow review before any use.
The declared SPDX identifier does not match the shipped conversion terms. Attorney review is pending (decisions D1-D7). Do not describe any release as open source.

exceptions.reason: historical release record — rewriting it falsifies history
audit documents quote the claims they report
legal specs quote prohibited wording in order to prohibit it
decision records quote the decision under review
the registry defines the prohibited strings
the linter necessarily contains the patterns
